<!-- Code generated by scripts/generate-docs.ts (run `npm run docs:generate`); DO NOT EDIT. -->

Open **File > Preferences > Settings** and search for "Achievements", or run **Achievements: Settings**.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| ------- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `achievements.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.logLevel` | string | `INFO` | Set the log level for the extension. One of `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR`, `FATAL`. |
| `achievements.notifications` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable Achievements extension notifications. |
| `achievements.logDirectory` | string | `""` | Specify the directory for log files. |
| `achievements.username` | string | `Guest` | Set your username for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.debug` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable debug events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.extensions` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable extensions / themes events listeners for the Achievements extension. This only tracks locally installed/enabled extensions and does not make any network request; see achievements.checkOutdatedExtensions for the opt-in Marketplace check. |
| `achievements.checkOutdatedExtensions` | boolean | `false` | Opt-in: periodically send the IDs of your installed (non-builtin) extensions to the VS Marketplace (marketplace.visualstudio.com) to check for outdated versions and award related achievements. Disabled by default since this is the only network request made by this extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.files` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable file events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.git` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable git events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.shortcuts` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable paste shortcut events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.tabs` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable tabs events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.tasks` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable tasks events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.listeners.time` | boolean | `true` | Enable or disable time events listeners for the Achievements extension. |
| `achievements.ignore.files` | array | `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `bun.lockb`, `.ds_store`, `thumbs.db` | File names ignored by file-related achievements (case-insensitive). |
| `achievements.ignore.directories` | array | `.git`, `.svn`, `.hg`, `.jj`, `node_modules` | Directory names ignored by file-related achievements (case-sensitive). |
